description: The pre-effects section of the Eagan Matrix: input level, and either the compressor or the tanh saturator; it works through a CHEM Core

params.text: Sets the level going into the effects, 0-10V, which drives the instrument into saturation and overdrive at high settings even with no compression
Sets how much of the compressed or saturated signal is mixed with the straight signal
Sets the compressor threshold, and the amount of drive when the selector is on Tanh, the panel printing Threshhold or Drive to match
Sets the compressor attack time; the selector on Tanh has nothing for it to do, and the knob greys out and the panel prints an em dash
Sets the compressor ratio, and the makeup gain when the selector is on Tanh, the panel printing Ratio or Makeup to match
Sets how far the voltage at the selected input moves its control, from -100% to 100%, a negative amount inverting the voltage; the knob does nothing until a cable is patched
Chooses whether the three knobs below act on the compressor or on the tanh saturator, and relabels them

inputs.text: Moves the pre-effects level away from its knob setting, bipolar, scaled by the modulation amount knob and clamped to 0-10V
Moves the compression or saturation mix away from its knob setting, bipolar, scaled by the modulation amount knob and clamped to 0-10V
Moves the threshold, or the drive on Tanh, away from its knob setting, bipolar, scaled by the modulation amount knob and clamped to 0-10V
Moves the compressor attack away from its knob setting, bipolar, scaled by the modulation amount knob and clamped to 0-10V
Moves the ratio, or the makeup gain on Tanh, away from its knob setting, bipolar, scaled by the modulation amount knob and clamped to 0-10V

notes: nothing reaches the instrument until the module is linked to a CHEM Core; putting it beside a linked CHEM module links it, or click the link button at the bottom of the panel to pick a Core
one input at a time is under the modulation amount knob; patching a cable moves the knob to that jack and lights the lamp beside it, and clicking a jack or its label moves the knob to that one
menu: Zero modulation — sets the modulation amount on every input of this module to zero
Center knobs — sets the mix, threshold, attack and ratio knobs to the middle of their range
